params.1273: Customize your ring of kinship to increase your abilities within Daemonheim.
params.1274: While in Daemonheim's dungeons, right-click your ring of kinship (in your regular or worn inventory) and select 'customise'.
params.1275: Select the desired tab: Melee, Ranged, Magic or Skill.
params.1276: Choose a category and upgrade your ring.
